# Payload Bay analysis guidance

Check the specification, plan and tasks for one coherent delivery scope, honest
existing/proposed behavior, acceptance and material failure coverage, test-before-
implementation ordering, verified scoped commands, broader-selection fallback and
complete final gates. A test may cover several requirements but must have one
execution owner. Missing commands, fictional baselines and duplicate evidence
are defects. Distinguish planning gaps from executed test failures. The preset
defines workflow expectations; actual execution results remain project evidence.

Use an available Graphify graph to locate cross-component relationships, following
the installed skill. Confirm source locations and freshness; graph edges are
navigation evidence, not proof that the current implementation satisfies a spec.
Use direct source searches when graph coverage is absent or stale.
